title: bridge: RQ-DRAIN2-PH-15
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-DRAIN2-PH-15` (pool: devin), single commit on base `e78f74b1f`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** test/m169.mcp-fleet-surface.test.ts test/mcp-native-fleet-apps-changes-03-sonn1.test.ts test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# BRIDGE_NOTES — RQ-DRAIN2-PH-15

Rework of conflicting PRs 3174, 3170, 3166, 3162, 3158, 3154 in `ashlrai/phantom`
onto current `master` (`629a1d27a`). All changes are uncommitted in this
worktree; `publish.sh` owns publishing.

Note on tooling: `gh` was unusable in this environment (no readable
`~/.config/gh`, no token), so PR heads were fetched as `refs/pull/N/head` and
intents were established from diffs, merge bases and git history instead of
`gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`.

## Per-PR outcomes

- `REWORKS_PR: 3174` — PR 3174 SUPERSEDED. `phantom_fleet_apps_follow` and
  `src/cli/fleet-apps-follow.ts` (plus tests) are already on master.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3170` — PR 3170 SUPERSEDED. The `apps-events` reader intent is
  covered by master's `apps-history` / `apps-recovery-history` retained-event
  reader (cursor + invocation filtering).
- `REWORKS_PR: 3166` — PR 3166 SUPERSEDED. `phantom_fleet_apps_history` and
  `src/core/fleet/apps-recovery-history.ts` are already on master.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3162` — reworked. Ported the evolved `fleet-apps-watch`
  supervision (`watchFleetApps`, `--attempt-timeout-ms`, `--max-recoveries`,
  `--bus`, structured observations) onto master's bus/recovery structure and
  added the `phantom_fleet_apps_watch` native MCP tool (append safety, closed
  schema, pre-handler validation, kill-switch aware). Failed/rejected attempts
  now preserve the last valid observed state instead of clearing it.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3158` — reworked. Added `src/core/fleet/apps-changes-bus.ts` and
  `--bus` opt-in publication to `fleet-apps-changes` (scoped
  apps-changes → leaders events, unique invocation IDs, best-effort: publish
  failures are counted, never fail the observation).
- `REWORKS_PR: 3154` — reworked. Ported the Fleet Forum + Fleet Mission
  feature (~4.1k LOC): forum domain/service/store/MCP/CLI, mission-control +
  `phm fleet mission` + `phm app state` alias, `GET
  /api/verse/fleet/runs/mission` + file-watched SSE invalidation, forum Verse
  API, channel-ingest hook after authenticated acceptance, Fleet Forum /
  Fleet Mission panes, mobile Forum screen, and docs/contracts. Semantic
  merges: unified master's `phm app update status` with the PR's
  `phm app state` under one `case 'app'`; kept master's newer
  connectors/channels/iMessage CLI surface while adding `forum`; regenerated
  `fleet-subcommand-registry.ts` and `docs/llms.txt` with the repo generators;
  kept master's dynamic native-tool contract tests and re-measured the
  mcp-output-efficiency budgets for the two new tools (55 tools, addedBytes
  allowance 10,653 = measured 10,633 + 20 commas, total ceiling 34,858 —
  same 658-byte historical headroom preserved, no unmeasured growth).
  `PR_BODY.md` from the PR was not ported (PR metadata, not source).

## Merge-conflict resolutions worth noting

- `src/cli/index.ts`: the textual merge produced two `case 'app':` blocks
  (master's `app update status`, PR's `app state`) — merged into one dispatcher
  (`state` → `cmdFleetMission`, `update status`/help → `cmdApp`, combined
  usage line). `case 'forum'` added once.
- `src/cli/completions.ts`: duplicate `app:` keys fixed; `app` completion now
  covers `update status state`; `forum` verbs added; master's richer
  `channels`/`connectors`/`memory`/`friction` entries kept.
- `test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts`: expected mount list = master's +
  `'forum'` last (matches `verse-api.ts` dispatch order).
- `test/m31/m129/m169`: kept master's `contractedNativeToolNames` catalog
  assertions (derived from `docs/MCP-TOOLS.md`, which now lists
  `phantom_forum` and `phantom_fleet_apps_watch`).
- `test/__snapshots__/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts.snap`: regenerated via
  `vitest run -u` after the union resolution.
- `docs/MCP-TOOLS.md`: both master's fleet-apps/recovery rows and the PR's
  `phantom_forum` row plus the new `phantom_fleet_apps_watch` row.
- `src/web-ui/routes/verse/panes/every-pane-sweep.test.tsx`: fixed a stale
  mock — `emptyPayload` returned `{}` for `/api/verse/activity`, which crashes
  `FeedSection` (`data.sources.chats`) since master's #3923 added the
  `sources.chats` read. Added a contract-shaped activity payload (all six
  NEEDS_YOU_SOURCES `'ok'`). Pre-existing master staleness, exposed by the
  enlarged pane set.
- `src/web-ui/design/font-ranges.test.ts`: the whole-`src/web-ui` glyph scan
  now exceeds the 5 s default after the PR's new UI files; gave that single
  test `{ timeout: 30000 }`. Assertion unchanged (verified it passes with no
  offenders).
- `test/mcp-native-fleet-apps-changes-03-sonn1.test.ts`: stale argv mock —
  master's #3887 added `--app` forwarding to `observeFleetAppsChanges` without
  updating this test's exact-argv expectation, so the mock's `toEqual` threw
  and every sample degraded to `unknown` (pre-existing master breakage; the
  observe function is untouched by this port — verified via `git diff`).
  Updated the expectation to the correct current argv
  `['fleet','apps-status','--json','--app',FLEET_APPS[0]]`; suite now 4/4.

## Commands run

- `git fetch origin refs/pull/{3174,3170,3166,3162,3158,3154}/head:pr/N`
- three-way merges of each PR head vs merge base; `scripts/gen-fleet-registry.mjs`
  and `scripts/generate-docs-llms.mjs` (+ `--check`) for generated files
- `npm run install:worktree` (pnpm 10.28.2 shared store; node_modules was a
  partial npm install missing eslint's `lib/`)
- `npm run typecheck` (tsc backend + `tsc -p src/web-ui/tsconfig.json`): PASS
- `npm run lint` (eslint + realio-lane + verse-sync-io): PASS — 0 errors,
  260 pre-existing warnings, none in touched files
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS — 0 errors (256 local, 327 source links)
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: PASS — file selection, fleet registry,
  eslint changed files, tsgo --noEmit, web typecheck, realio lane, verse
  sync-io, dedupe; recorded tree `216f38d1c849` (final run, after the last
  test-file edit)
- `npm run test:ci --` (temp HOME):
  - `test/fleet-apps-watch-unknown-03-sons1.test.ts`,
    `test/mcp-native-fleet-apps-watch-03-sont1.test.ts`,
    `test/fleet-apps-changes-bus-03-sonv1.test.ts` — 3 files, 18 tests, PASS
  - Fleet apps watch/changes suite, all 14 files —
    `fleet-apps-watch-03-sone1`, `-attempt-budget-03-sonz1`, `-bus-03-sonu1`,
    `-bus-coalesce-03-sonx1`, `-diagnostics-03sony1`, `-restart-cap-03-sonw1`,
    `-retry-03-song1`, `-stop-file-03sonf1`, `fleet-apps-changes-03-sonh1`,
    `-selection-03-sonm1`, `-stop-file-03-sonr1`, `-bus-03-sonv1`,
    `mcp-native-fleet-apps-watch-03-sont1`,
    `mcp-native-fleet-apps-changes-03-sonn1` — 110 tests, PASS
  - `test/fleet-forum.test.ts`, `test/fleet-forum-sim.test.ts`,
    `test/fleet-mission.test.ts`, `test/fleet-mission-stream.test.ts`,
    `test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts`, `test/docs-fleet-verbs.test.ts` —
    6 files, 79 tests, PASS
  - `test/mcp-output-efficiency.test.ts`, `test/m31.native-tools.test.ts`,
    `test/m129.agent-surface.test.ts`, `test/m169.mcp-fleet-surface.test.ts`,
    `test/doc-facts.test.ts` — 5 files, 82 tests, PASS
- `npx vitest run --config vitest.config.web.ts` (temp HOME), targeted:
  - `fleet-forum/`, `fleet-mission/`, `mobile/` (model + ForumScreen),
    `fleet-hub/`, `font-ranges`, `subset-glyphs`, `every-pane-sweep`,
    `Dock.add-menu` — all PASS (98 + 7 + 90 + 43 tests across runs)
  - Manual CLI smoke (temp HOME): `phm app state --json`,
    `phm fleet mission --json`, `phm forum channels --json`, `phm app
    --help` — all emit valid `fleet.mission.v1` / forum docs with missing
    sources reported `unknown`, never invented.

## Pass/fail counts

- Deterministic gates: typecheck PASS, lint PASS (0 errors), check:docs PASS,
  verify-changed PASS (tree `216f38d1c849`).
- Backend affected tests: 281/281 unique tests PASS across runs — 110
  fleet-apps watch/changes (14 files), 79 forum/mission/verse/docs (6 files),
  82 MCP-surface/doc-facts (5 files), plus `fleet-apps-watch-unknown-03-sons1`
  (10 tests; the other two files in that earlier 3-file batch overlap the
  110-run).
- Web affected tests: all tests in touched areas PASS (forum, mission, mobile,
  fleet-hub, pane sweep, glyph scans, dock menu).
- Full `npm run test:web`: attempted twice; could not complete cleanly —
  the machine was at load average ~60 (other fleet worktrees running vitest
  concurrently), so unrelated timing-sensitive suites flaked on 5 s
  timeouts. Every failure inspected was either a timeout flake, the jsdom
  store race during `install:worktree` healing (files verified present
  afterwards), or one of the two real issues above (both fixed and verified
  green in isolation). No failure was attributable to the ported code.

## Net LOC

- Tracked modifications vs `629a1d27a`: 33 files, +485 / −60.
- New untracked paths (forum/, fleet-forum/, fleet-mission/, mission-control,
  forum-api, docs, tests, mobile screen, bus publisher): ~3,713 lines
  (excludes this file and the binary `artifacts/apptruth-mission.png`).
- Net: ≈ +4,140 LOC (≈ +4,198 added, 60 removed; excludes the binary
  `artifacts/apptruth-mission.png` and skipped `PR_BODY.md`).

## Left uncommitted / not done

- Everything above is uncommitted, per job rules. No push, commit, PR
  create/merge/close, or `gh api` writes were performed.
- `.github/` untouched. No secrets printed or added.
</details>

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a Fleet Mission dashboard with fleet health, activity, merges, resources, and attention items, available in the app and through read-only CLI and API views.
  * Added a Fleet Forum for viewing discussions and commitments on desktop and mobile, with CLI and MCP access.
  * Added optional forum mirroring to supported messaging services and verified channel-message ingestion.
  * Added fleet app monitoring and change-event reporting, plus an idle-pass limit for guardian runs.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved fleet queue observation-age display and clarified unknown or unavailable readings.
  * Updated reporting for disk cleanup eligibility, lane suggestions, and fleet summaries.
